title: File:Michael Hutchence memorial, Sydney.jpg
desc: Memorial to Michael Hutchence at Northern Suburbs Crematorium, North Ryde, New South Wales, Australia. As the inscriptions reads, Hutchence's ashes were scattered in Rose Bay on 22 January 1998
